How did I get this book?

I got this book as a gift from my teacher.

One day, our teacher organized a book competition. I won the competition, and my teacher gave me this book.

At first, I thought it was too long. But the story was very interesting. I finished it in only three or four days.

I really enjoyed reading it.

02/ 09
Jack London (1876–1916)

About the author

Jack London was an American writer and journalist.

He was born on January 12, 1876, in San Francisco, California.

He had a difficult childhood and started working at a young age.

He travelled to different places and had many interesting life experiences.

These experiences inspired him to write stories about people, nature and life.

He became famous for his exciting and meaningful novels.

His most famous books include Martin Eden, The Call of the Wild and White Fang.

Jack London died in 1916, but his books are still popular around the world.

03/ 09

About the story

The main character is Martin Eden.

He is a simple sailor. One day, he meets a girl named Ruth. He falls in love with her.

Ruth comes from a rich family. Martin wants to become an educated person. He reads many books and studies by himself.

His dream is to become a writer. But many publishers do not accept his stories.

He does not give up and continues working hard.

04/ 09

Main characters

Martin Eden – the main character. He is hardworking and ambitious.

Ruth Morse – a girl Martin loves. She comes from a rich family.

Brissenden – a poet and Martin’s friend.

These characters make the story interesting.

05/ 09

Martin’s life changes

Martin’s life changes a lot.

First, he is poor. He studies hard and dreams of becoming a writer.

Later, he becomes a famous and rich writer.

People who did not respect him before now admire him.

But Martin is not happy. He thinks that people like him only because he is famous.

06/ 09

The surprising ending

The ending of the book is very sad.

Martin gets everything he wanted. He becomes famous and rich. Ruth also comes back to him.

But Martin does not love her like before. He is tired of his life and feels lonely.

At the end of the story, he jumps into the sea.

This ending surprised me and made me think a lot.

07/ 09

What did I learn from this book?

This book taught me many important things.

  1. We should work hard to achieve our dreams.

  2. Education and knowledge are very important in life.

  3. Money and fame do not always bring happiness.

  4. We should value sincere people and true feelings.

  5. We should not depend on other people’s opinions.

  6. It is important to enjoy life, not only think about the future.

  7. We should never lose ourselves while following our dreams.

In my opinion, Martin’s story shows that success is not everything. A person also needs love, peace and a reason to live.

This book made me think more deeply about life and happiness.

08/ 09

Conclusion

Martin Eden is one of the most interesting books I have ever read.

I liked this book because it has a deep meaning and an unexpected ending.

It made me think about dreams, love, success and happiness.

I learned that hard work is important, but success does not always make people happy.

I also understood that we should enjoy life, value sincere people and never lose ourselves.

I think everyone should read this book at least once. It can teach us many important things about life.

Thank you for your attention!
